flags.c3a_045_a2: wizard-config.yaml has controller.mpc_implementation: kinematic_ideal while every other run (including references) uses linear, so it is not the batch's setup; physics.txt confirms anomalous motion (max_abs_accel 8.132 m/s^2, p99_abs_jerk 102.7, +6.66 m/s^2 at 2.4 m/s) and plan_deviation 0.49 vs ~0.32 for the same scene.

rules.reason: The batch setup and all known-good reference runs use the linear MPC; a different controller implementation changes what the run's tracking and motion metrics measure.
